test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six friends B, D, F, H, J and L are sitting around a circular table facing the center (but not necessarily in the same order). F is the immediate neighbor of D and J. L is sitting to the immediate left of B. H is the immediate neighbour of D and L. Who is sitting to the immediate left of J?
solution:
Given: Six friends B, D, F, H, J and L. 

1) L is sitting to the immediate left of B.

2) H is the immediate neighbor of D and L.

3) F is the immediate neighbor of D and J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/748c12d52d6ed8ab311feda312c8d81b71abb18ea2582cd55e67a4a7fd714b18.png] 

So, 'B' is sitting to the immediate left of J.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
